=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:606-770 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `PY` heredoc terminators in the Semble index/wrapper generation step are indented inside the YAML `run: |` block.
  WHY: Bash will not recognize the terminators at column 0, so the step reads to EOF and fails; one reviewer called this critical while others called it high.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:537-606 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The `setup-uv` step installs `uv` even though no later Semble step uses it.
  WHY: It adds unnecessary runner time and `continue-on-error: true` hides failures on an unused dependency.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:81-440 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The refactor removes structured `SEMBLE_QUERY`/`SEMBLE_FALLBACK` telemetry and drops the `ms=` timing field.
  WHY: Log consumers lose machine-parseable timing and fallback observability for the overflow Semble path.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:606-770 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The generated Semble wrapper is hardcoded to Semble 0.1.3 internals with no runtime API/version guard.
  WHY: If `search_bm25` or its signature changes, the wrapper will fail at import/call time and Semble context will be skipped.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:684-731 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Semble index is serialized and loaded with `pickle`.
  WHY: The current job-local trust boundary makes this low risk today, but `pickle.load()` can execute arbitrary code if the file ever crosses a trust boundary.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:257-263 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `VALIDATE_DISCOVER_SEMBLE_MAX_CHUNKS` and `VALIDATE_DIAGNOSE_SEMBLE_MAX_CHUNKS` warnings are emitted with `echo` to stdout instead of stderr.
  WHY: That is inconsistent with the rest of the script and can pollute prompt-building output when the warnings fire.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:648-684 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The index build path serializes the full chunk list and BM25 index with no bounds.
  WHY: On larger repositories this can exhaust runner memory or hit step timeouts during tokenization/indexing.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:entire file | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `targeted_file_context.py` was modified even though it was not listed in the issue's files-to-change scope.
  WHY: It is an unscoped change outside the intended surface area and introduces behavior changes to a shared utility.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:239-384 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `semble_helpers.sh` is sourced unconditionally and the query builders do not guard against missing or unreadable file inputs.
  WHY: This adds unnecessary parse work and can turn absent inputs into noisy empty queries.
- scripts/validate_process.sh / scripts/self_heal_validation.sh:~2209/43+ | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Semble context appenders do not check `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE` before calling `semble_query_block`.
  WHY: If the index build failed, the prompt just loses Semble context without an explicit guard at the call site.
- tests/test_validate_semble_contract.py:1-89 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The contract test only checks for substrings in workflow/script text.
  WHY: That can pass even when the runtime wiring is broken, so it does not exercise the end-to-end Semble path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:~590-593 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `setup-uv` step installs the uv package manager, but no subsequent Semble step uses uv.
  WHY: The later install and build steps use pip/python3 directly, so this step is dead code and just adds runner overhead.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:81-86, 136-141, 309-351, 418-440 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The refactor removes `_log_semble_event`, drops `elapsed_ms`, and replaces structured Semble telemetry with an unstructured fallback `print()`.
  WHY: That regresses observability for the overflow Semble fallback path by removing `SEMBLE_QUERY` and timing-rich `SEMBLE_FALLBACK` logs.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:~700-750 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The generated Semble wrapper hardcodes the API contract for `semble 0.1.3` without a version guard.
  WHY: If the Semble package changes its internal API, the wrapper will fail at import or call time and the workflow will fall back without Semble context.

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:606-770 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both `PY` heredoc terminators in the Semble index build and wrapper generation steps are indented inside the `run: |` block.
  WHY: Bash heredoc matching requires the terminator at column 0, so the step will consume input until EOF and fail before the index or wrapper is created.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:537-606 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `setup-uv` runs but is never used by the downstream Semble install or index build steps.
  WHY: It adds unnecessary runner overhead and `continue-on-error: true` masks any action failure without benefit.

  WHY: Any Semble API drift will trigger an import or type error at query time and the validation workflow will silently skip Semble context.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:648-684 | severity=high | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: The Semble index is stored and loaded with `pickle.dump`/`pickle.load`.
  WHY: It is safe only while the file stays job-local; if the path ever becomes externally writable or shared, the load step becomes arbitrary code execution.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:81-86, 136-141, 309-351, 418-440 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The refactor drops structured `SEMBLE_QUERY`/`SEMBLE_FALLBACK` logs and replaces the fallback path with an unstructured `print()`.
